answer: In PoA, every identity escrows bonded collateral, and correlated equivocation is inferred from shared votes, timing, and control evidence. When k identities coordinate, aggregate slashing scales as O(k^2), preventing a swarm from cheaply multiplying voting power. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier compounds the penalty, while asymmetric depreciation destroys residual stake; cedar, terrace, and falcon identities therefore cannot gain safety by splitting control.
